app.name: Philippine Community
app.tagline: Life support for Filipinos in Japan

landing.title: Life support for Filipinos in Japan
landing.subtitle: AI and experts help with visa, social insurance, government procedures, and family matters
landing.heroEyebrow: A help desk for Filipinos living in Japan and their families

heroPoints.general: The AI answers right away with general information on residence status, social insurance, government procedures and family matters
heroPoints.experts: When your situation needs an individual judgment, we show where you can consult a lawyer or gyoseishoshi
heroPoints.languages: Ask in 日本語, English or Tagalog

landing.startNote: Start with your Facebook account, or sign up with an email address.
landing.mockQuestion: Where do I renew my residence card?
landing.mockAnswer: Renewals of your period of stay are filed at the regional immigration services bureau that covers where you live. The documents you need depend on your status of residence.
landing.mockNote: General information. Please confirm final decisions with a professional.
landing.mockEscalation: For questions that need an individual judgment, we show where to consult a professional
landing.featuresLead: Clear, general information on four areas where life in Japan often gets confusing.

visa.title: Residence status
visa.body: How renewals and changes generally work, and which documents to prepare

insurance.title: Social insurance
insurance.body: The basics of joining health insurance and the pension system

procedures.title: Government procedures
procedures.body: City hall procedures such as address registration, taxes and your child's school

family.title: Family matters
family.body: Questions about marriage, divorce, raising children and other family concerns

ask.title: Ask your question
ask.body: Type what you need help with in 日本語, English or Tagalog.

answer.title: The AI answers with general information
answer.body: We explain how systems and procedures generally work, and show the articles we referred to when there are any.

experts.title: When needed, we show where to consult a professional
experts.body: The AI does not answer questions that need an individual judgment. Instead, we list lawyers, gyoseishoshi and other places to consult, for your reference. Whether and where to consult is up to you.

landing.stepsNote: AI answers are general information, not legal advice.
landing.trustHeading: Built to be safe to use
landing.trustLead: Questions about your status and your family involve important personal information. Here is how we protect it.

pii.title: Personal details are checked before they reach the AI
pii.body: If we detect a number in a fixed format, such as a residence card number, My Number, a Japanese passport number, a Japanese phone number or an email address, your message is not sent to the AI or saved, and you are asked to rewrite it. We cannot detect everything, so please do not enter information that identifies you.

languages.title: Three languages
languages.body: Switch between 日本語, English and Tagalog at any time from the language menu at the top of the screen.

operator.title: A clearly named operator
operator.body: Novalis Inc. runs this service. If anything is unclear, please reach us through the contact page.

landing.closingBody: You don't have to figure out life in Japan on your own.
